description: A sturdy L-shaped shelf bracket with mounting holes
print_notes: Print flat on the back face. Use 100% infill for maximum strength. PETG or ABS recommended for load-bearing applications.
code:
import cadquery as cq

# Parameters
width = 100
depth = 120
thickness = 10
fillet_radius = 15
mount_hole_diameter = 6

# Create vertical back plate
back_plate = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .rect(width, depth)
    .extrude(thickness)
)

# Create horizontal shelf support
shelf_support = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(width, depth)
    .extrude(thickness)
)

# Combine the two plates
bracket = back_plate.union(shelf_support)

# Add fillet to the inside corner for strength
bracket = bracket.edges("|Y").fillet(fillet_radius)

# Add mounting holes to back plate
bracket = (
    bracket.faces(">Y")
    .workplane(centerOption="CenterOfBoundBox")
    .rarray(width - 20, depth - 20, 2, 2)
    .circle(mount_hole_diameter / 2)
    .cutThruAll()
)

# Add countersink for screws
bracket = (
    bracket.faces(">Y")
    .workplane(centerOption="CenterOfBoundBox")
    .rarray(width - 20, depth - 20, 2, 2)
    .circle(mount_hole_diameter)
    .cutBlind(-thickness / 2)
)

result = bracket
